Both test claims carry the family alpha 0.05 with correction bonferroni as the plan registers, but no artifact states the per-test threshold 0.025; the conclusions do not depend on it because both p values are effectively zero (z 26.72, Welch t 42.70).
Both test p values are stored as 0.0000000000 with display_digits 4; a release surface should render them as below 0.0001 rather than as a literal zero.

check_plan covers the numbers well but has no rule that reads the content of the answers in analysis/answers/ (questions_are_answered only checks presence), and caveats_declared does not require delivered-only or net-of-refunds topics for AOV claims; both gaps are where this stage's findings sit.
